fusions.name: Shoaling Seeds
fusions.desc: Looses 3 seeds that swim out in a spread, each one that hits dealing 6 damage. 20% of the damage dealt comes back to you as healing over the following 4 seconds. Holds 4 charges; each use spends one, and each kill restores one.

fusions.name: Kelp Undertow
fusions.desc: You slip up to 6 tiles to the target and strike it for 13 damage, wrapping it in stinging kelp that leaves it [Poisoned] for 2 damage a second for 3 seconds and 25% slower for 3 seconds.

fusions.name: Mucilage Coat
fusions.desc: Coats you in slick plant slime for 12 seconds, raising your dodge chance by 25%. You restore 10 health.

fusions.name: Eelgrass Bed
fusions.desc: Every attack you dodge builds a stack on you, up to 4. At 4 stacks they all spend at once and heal you for 6% of your maximum health per stack (24% in all). A stack fades every 8 seconds if none is added.
